module origen_154827 #(
    parameter N = 4
) (
    // Outputs
    output reg [7:0] data_00,
    output reg [7:0] data_11,
    output reg valid_00,
    output reg valid_11,
    output reg clk_4f,
    output reg clk_2f,
    output reg reset,

    // Inputs
    input [7:0] data_000_synt,
    input [7:0] data_000_cond,
    input valid_000_synt,
    input valid_000_cond
);

    initial begin
        // Initialize output signals
        data_00 = 8'h00;
        data_11 = 8'h00;
        valid_00 = 2'b00;
        valid_11 = 2'b00;
        reset = 1'b0;

        // Generate clocks
        clk_4f = 1'b0;
        clk_2f = 1'b0;
        forever #(N) clk_4f = ~clk_4f;
        forever #(2*N) clk_2f = ~clk_2f;

        // Release reset after 10 time units
        #(10*N) reset = 1'b1;

        // Generate output signals
        repeat (2) begin
            #(4*N) data_00 = 8'hff;
            valid_00 = 2'b11;
            #(4*N) data_00 = 8'h00;
            valid_00 = 2'b00;
        end

        repeat (2) begin
            #(4*N) data_11 = 8'hdd;
            valid_11 = 2'b11;
            #(4*N) data_11 = 8'h00;
            valid_11 = 2'b00;
        end

        #(8*N) $finish;
    end

endmodule
